entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey. You're finally taking off tomorrow...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro said you don't have to help out[n]here today.
entries.uk: Соджіро сказав, що сьогодні тобі не[n]треба тут допомагати.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Go and see your friends before you leave.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Who do you think you are?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I bet he's just bad at saying goodbye.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Is that so? Well, doesn't matter. C'mon,[n]off you go.
entries.uk: Он як? Ну, байдуже. Давай, біжи вже.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Seriously? You need to do this stuff[n]properly.
entries.uk: Серйозно? Такі речі треба робити[n]як слід.
